sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The Custodian lets out a shrill cry. "The Keystone has finally responded! Surround me, the ritual must begin or I'll lose the pathway! Hurry!" Her glow swells, her eyes roll back, and the carriage lifts a foot off the ground. From the woods comes a chorus of unearthly screeches. The ground rumbles. Rusted swords break the surface as dead things claw their way up. In the distance, two shapes drift toward you, screeching, wrong. Hold the line until she's done.

Gmnotes: Market Correction is available as a GM pressure valve, not player-facing terminology.

Gmscript: Say: "d8, starting at 8. Defeat an enemy or remove a real pressure, it ticks down one. She gets hit or exposed, it ticks up one. At zero, the ritual is done and you win. The math is simple; staying alive is not."

Gmreadaloud: "The Keystone has finally responded! Surround me, the ritual must begin or I'll lose the pathway!" The carriage lifts a foot off the ground. Rusted swords break the surface as dead things claw their way up. Two shapes drift in the distance, screeching, wrong.

Gmchecklist: Place Custodian center, PCs around her, 4 rusted-sword skeletons Close, and 2 screeching wraiths Far. Set ritual_countdown=8. If ward_stability=stable, soften the first exposure or give a prepared defense a free success beat; if fragile or missing, full canon pressure. If ritual_prep=ready, let the prepared PC explain the countdown in character. Initialize protected_whom as unresolved and start watching who covers whom.
Gmprivate: Use description before names: rusted-sword dead, floating screeching wraiths. Names and deeper meaning can come after the table understands what they see.
Playertakeaway: This is the fight that ends the story: keep her safe and run the clock down.
Storytakeaway: The ritual is live and irreversible now; the only way out is through.
Mechanictakeaway: The countdown die is the win condition: d8 starts at 8, down on enemy defeat or pressure removed, up when the Custodian is hit.

Storyscope: Perceived antagonist: the forest. True antagonist: the corporate lie about the forest. The players never confront it directly. They are meant to feel it by the end. Every act offers at least one guaranteed and one earned hint that the danger is manufactured and the forest is not the enemy. Soul-Audit Wraiths bear audit glyphs and say, "Unlicensed soul-resonance detected. Submit for audit." REFLAVOR GUARANTEED A defeated wraith leaves a Soulspire compliance tag or coil-credit token instead of natural remains. ADD GUARANTEED Wraiths ignore forest creatures and home only on ritual soul-magic. ADD EARNED Instinct Medium 15 A player can read the markings and name Soulspire without the GM naming it first. ADD EARNED Knowledge Medium 15 Optional flag: Legacy Skeletons carry scraps of old corporate credentials. FLAG SEED Instinct: target logic. Knowledge: read markings.
